title: There is a metro station called Upper Kharadi Road: where the Ramwadi-Wagholi metro really stands
audience: IT professionals and families, 28-45, in east Pune (Kharadi, Viman Nagar, Wagholi), budget ₹1.5-4 crore, hearing 'metro is coming' in sales pitches; English
message: Metro Line 2B (Ramwadi to Wagholi/Vitthalwadi, 11.63 km, 11 stations) has a station called Upper Kharadi Road; it was approved in June 2025, work began at Ramwadi in September 2026, the first phase stops at Tulja Bhavani Chowk, and no opening date is announced for Ubale Nagar or Upper Kharadi Road.
facts: Pune Metro Line 2B, Ramwadi to Wagholi/Vitthalwadi, is 11.63 km with 11 stations: Viman Nagar, Somnath Nagar, Kharadi Bypass, Tulaja Bhavani, Ubale Nagar, Upper Kharadi Road, Wagheshwar Temple, Wagholi, Siddharth Nagar, Bakori Phata, Vitthalwadi. Source: punemetrorail.org, read 18 October 2026.
The Union Cabinet approved Phase 2 (lines 2A and 2B, ₹3,626 crore) in June 2025 and gave it four years.
Maha Metro invited bids for the Ramwadi-Wagholi viaduct and a six-lane elevated road in February 2026.

In September 2026 preparatory work began at Ramwadi: barricading and soil tests. The first phase being built is about 4.7 km, from Ramwadi to Tulja Bhavani Chowk. Source: Punekar News, 5 September 2026.
Ubale Nagar and Upper Kharadi Road stations come after the first phase; no opening date has been announced.
